description: Its value comes from props (`value`) and changes are requested through a callback (`onChange`). The parent is the source of truth.
Keeps its own value; the parent only provides an initial `defaultValue` and reads the result later (for inputs, via `FormData` or a ref).
Browser API that reads every named field of a form: `new FormData(form).get('email')`.
`value !== undefined`. Decide once and never switch modes during the component's life.
Common library hook that implements the controlled/uncontrolled switch for custom components.
